summary: service's use option forces a specific service manager module instead of autodetecting from ansible_service_mgr.
questions: How do I force the service module to use sysvinit?
How does the service module pick a backend?

answer_card.title: service use option
answer_card.answer_md: `use` (auto): force a specific backend; default uses `ansible_service_mgr` and falls back to `ansible.legacy.service`.
